speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are here for acute diarrhea; to help you, please tell me how many loose stools you have passed in the last 24 hours. Have you experienced any fever, severe abdominal pain, or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea, likely due to *Clostridioides difficile* infection, given the recent levofloxacin use for pneumonia. I will request a stool test to confirm this.
